description: This file contains a Java class configuring Spring Security for a web application. It sets up password encoding, authority mapping, authentication provider, security filter chain, and exposes an AuthenticationManager. It manages security settings such as login, logout, access permissions, and H2 database console configuration.

classes.name: ApplicationSecurityConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up security in a Spring Boot application, including password encoding, authorities mapping, authentication provider, security filter chain, and authentication manager exposure.

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Creates and returns a BCryptPasswordEncoder with strength 11 for hashing passwords.

methods.name: authoritiesMapper
methods.description: Configures authority mapping to convert roles to uppercase, assign a default 'USER' role, and prefix roles with 'ROLE_'.

methods.name: authenticationProvider
methods.description: Sets up a DaoAuthenticationProvider with a custom UserDetailsService, password encoder, and authorities mapper.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines HTTP security settings, including permitted endpoints, login/logout pages, CSRF disablement for H2 console, and integration of the DAO authentication provider.

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Provides an AuthenticationManager bean for use in authentication processes.
